$comment: Generated API clients: which OpenAPI document each is typed from, and where
its output goes. Adding a client is a data edit, not a new script.
The document supplies the shape of each operation. The resolved deployment
graph supplies who may call it — see docs/adr/0023-generated-api-clients.md.
The two cannot be collapsed: `x-voyant-key-kind` is stamped at composition
time and appears in none of the tracked documents.
`keyKinds` is false for admin clients. The PK/SK line is a property of the
public surface; every /v1/admin/* route is secret-only by construction, so a
publishable subset there would be an empty type pretending to be a boundary.
